title: The Switch Buried the PS5 in Sales
source: Sources: Nintendo and Sony official investor earnings releases, cumulative hardware shipments as of each fiscal year-end (Nintendo and Sony both close their fiscal year in March). 2026 Switch figure combines the original Switch (~153M as of June 2025) with Switch 2 (19.86M shipped by March 2026); PS5 total is as of June 2026 per Sony's Q1 FY26 report.
